report:
Soft tissue, bilateral inguinal hernia sacs, excision

Received in formalin are two membranous sacs labelled bilateral inguinal hernia sacs, measuring 4 x 3 x 0.5 cm in aggregate. Representative sections in 1 block.

(1) Hernia sacs, representative sections.

Sections show peritoneal fibroadipose tissue lined by benign mesothelium. No vas deferens or epididymal tissue is identified. Features are in keeping with hernia sacs. There is no evidence of granulomatous inflammation or malignancy.

SOFT TISSUE, bilateral inguinal hernia sacs, excision - In keeping with HERNIA SACS
